source.name: National Earthquake Monitoring and Research Centre (National Seismological Centre), Department of Mines and Geology, Nepal
source.method: HTML table scrape; no public API was available
source.magnitude_scale: ML (local magnitude), computed by NEMRC independently of USGS

note: NEMRC values are not reconciled with USGS values for the same event. Where both catalogues list an event, the magnitudes will differ and both are shown as reported.

events.epicentre: Around Annapurna II (Border of Kaski and Manang)
